latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Compressor for Discord.

- Upload videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and compress them for Discord, targeting 8MB 720p MP4 output.
- Automatic cloud connection and token management on first use; 100 free credits included.
- Simple prompt-based interface with quick actions for upload, export, credits, and status checking.
- Full session management for project continuity and iterative edits.
- Comprehensive error handling and workflow tips provided for smooth Discord video sharing.
